title: AI Multi-Agent Orchestrator
codeSnippet:
class AgentOrchestrator:
    def __init__(self, rag_engine, tools):
        self.rag = rag_engine
        self.tools = tools
        self.agents = [ResearchAgent(), CodeAgent(), QAAgent()]
    
    async def execute_task(self, prompt: str) -> ExecutionResult:
        # 1. Retrieve domain context via Vector RAG
        context = await self.rag.retrieve_top_k(prompt, k=5)
        # 2. Plan and delegate to specialized subagents
        plan = await self.agents[0].create_plan(prompt, context)
        return await self.dispatch_parallel(plan)
desc: Autonomous multi-agent orchestration framework featuring Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), intelligent subagent delegation, dynamic tool execution, and automated QA pipelines.

title: Global-NewsStream-Enterprise-Lakehouse-Real-Time-Media-Intelligence-Platform
codeSnippet:
from airflow import DAG
from airflow.operators.bash import BashOperator
from datetime import datetime

# Orchestrate real-time news data ingestion, processing, and storage
with DAG(dag_id='news_stream_etl', start_date=datetime(2023, 1, 1), schedule_interval='@daily', catchup=False) as dag:
    # Ingest data from external sources via scrapers
    ingest = BashOperator(task_id='ingest_raw_news', bash_command='python /app/scrapers/run.py')

    # Process and transform raw data into a structured format
    transform = BashOperator(task_id='process_news_data', bash_command='spark-submit /app/pipelines/transform.py')

    # Load transformed data into the data warehouse
    load = BashOperator(task_id='load_to_warehouse', bash_command='python /app/warehouse/load.py')

    # Define the data flow
    ingest >> transform >> load
desc: This project is a comprehensive, distributed Real-Time Media Intelligence Platform designed for ingesting, processing, and visualizing news article data from various sources. It leverages an enterprise lakehouse architecture with real-time streaming, automated ETL/ELT pipelines, and robust visualization tools to deliver actionable media insights.
features: Real-time Data Ingestion & Stream Processing: Implements distributed scrapers and Apache Kafka for high-throughput, real-time ingestion and processing of news media streams.
Enterprise Lakehouse Architecture (Medallion Pattern): Establishes a scalable data lake (MinIO) and data warehouse following a Medallion architecture for raw, bronze, silver, and gold data layers.
Automated ETL/ELT Pipelines with Apache Airflow: Orchestrates complex data transformation workflows using Airflow DAGs for efficient data cleaning, enrichment, and loading into the data warehouse.

Integrated Monitoring, Visualization, & Cloud Deployment: Provides end-to-end operational visibility with Prometheus and Grafana, interactive dashboards via Apache Superset, and containerized deployment with Docker/Kubernetes.
